title: Reader identity: readerSubject accessor and reader API skeleton
description:
As a publication, I want reader requests keyed only on a per-site pairwise siteSubject so that no global person id ever reaches reader data.

Feature: Reader identity fails closed
  Scenario: No siteSubject in production
    Given a signed-in reader whose session has no siteSubject
    When they call any /api/reader route
    Then the answer is 503 reader_identity_unavailable
  Scenario: Signed out
    Given no session
    When they call GET /api/reader/me
    Then the answer is 401
  Scenario: Wrong origin
    Given a signed-in reader with a siteSubject
    When a POST arrives with a foreign Origin
    Then the answer is 403

Definition of Done: lib/reader-subject.ts, app/api/reader/* routes, reader-steering plugin skeleton (models, config, reader-actions Lambda, wire), tests, docs/reader-steering.md.
